question: What are the IATA codes for the US major airports, as classified by the US Department of Transportation, which saw improvements of at least one ranking position of their On-Time Arrival Rankings from the 2023 calendar year to the 2024 calendar year, where the on time percentage in 2024 was at least 77.0% and no greater than 81.5%? answer:
Based on my extensive search through the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) resources and related data sources, I must inform you that I was unable to retrieve the complete **Table 4** datasets containing the full rankings and percentages for both calendar year 2023 and 2024 needed to definitively answer your question.

Here's what I found:

## Available Information

1. **BTS Table 4 exists** - The Bureau of Transportation Statistics publishes "Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance" as Table 4 annually

2. **Data source confirmed** - An embedded Excel dataset is available at [bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports](https://www.bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports)

3. **Reference files exist** - Multiple documents cite "Table 4: Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance Year-to-date December 2003–December 2024" and "2023"

4. **Sample partial data points** found in searches:
   - Charlotte CLT: 79.37% in 2025 (up from 76% in 2024)
   - JFK: ~77.3% departures in 2025, below national rate
   - SLC mentioned as having high on-time performance in 2025

## Limitation

To accurately identify airports meeting ALL your criteria:
- Classified as US major airports by DOT
- Improved by at least one ranking position from 2023 to 2024
- 2024 on-time percentage ≥77.0% and ≤81.5%

I would need direct access to the complete BTS Table 4 spreadsheets for both 2023 and 2024 calendar years, which contain:
- Complete ranking positions for each major airport
- On-time arrival percentages for each airport
- All US DOT-defined major airports included in the ranking

**Recommendation:** To get this information, I recommend:
1. Download the "Table 4 Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance" Excel files directly from the BTS website for years 2023 and 2024
2. Filter for US airports only
3. Calculate rank improvements (new rank minus old rank = positive value means improvement)
4. Filter for 2024 on-time percentages between 77.0% and 81.5%

# Airline On-Time Tables
These tables created by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) summarize and provide historical comparisons of monthly on-time reports filed by large airlines. Flights are on-time if they depart from the gate or arrive at the gate less than 15 minutes after their scheduled departure or arrival times. For annual rankings, click on December, then select the year-to-date rankings.

# What are the best and worst airports and airlines for on-time performance?
Nearly 25% of domestic flights in the second quarter of 2025 did not arrive on-time — the tardiest performance since 2014.
Updated Oct 14, 2025 by theUSAFacts team
As of late September 2025, an average of more than 2.4 million people on average were clearing security in American airports every day. That figure is about 9% higher than the number of passengers in September 2019, the last comparison before the pandemic.
Two million commercial domestic flights were scheduled from April to June of 2025, about 3.5% lower than the same period in 2019.
In spring 2025, nearly a quarter of flights did not arrive on time. That’s the tardiest second quarter for commercial air travel since 2014.
The Bureau of Transportation Statistics defines a flight as on time if it arrives within 15 minutes of the originally scheduled time.

## What airlines are the best for on-time performance?
Nearly half of the commercial airlines in the US had fewer flights in the first half of 2025 compared with the same period in 2019. Twelve airlines — or 57% — had worse on-time performances in 2025 than in 2019.

# Airline On-Time Tables
These tables created by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) summarize and provide historical comparisons of monthly on-time reports filed by large airlines. Flights are on-time if they depart from the gate or arrive at the gate less than 15 minutes after their scheduled departure or arrival times. For annual rankings, click on December, then select the year-to-date rankings.
Additional on-time information can be found in the Air Travel Consumer Report, http://www.transportation.gov/individuals/air-consumer/air-travel-consumer-reports.

# What are the best and worst airports and airlines for on-time performance?
Nearly 25% of domestic flights in the second quarter of 2025 did not arrive on-time — the tardiest performance since 2014.
Updated Oct 14, 2025 by theUSAFacts team
As of late September 2025, an average of more than 2.4 million people on average were clearing security in American airports every day. That figure is about 9% higher than the number of passengers in September 2019, the last comparison before the pandemic.
Two million commercial domestic flights were scheduled from April to June of 2025, about 3.5% lower than the same period in 2019.
In spring 2025, nearly a quarter of flights did not arrive on time. That’s the tardiest second quarter for commercial air travel since 2014.
The Bureau of Transportation Statistics defines a flight as on time if it arrives within 15 minutes of the originally scheduled time.

# Airline On-Time Tables
These tables created by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) summarize and provide historical comparisons of monthly on-time reports filed by large airlines. Flights are on-time if they depart from the gate or arrive at the gate less than 15 minutes after their scheduled departure or arrival times. For annual rankings, click on December, then select the year-to-date rankings.
Additional on-time information can be found in the Air Travel Consumer Report, http://www.transportation.gov/individuals/air-consumer/air-travel-consumer-reports.

# What are the best and worst airports and airlines for on-time performance?
Nearly 25% of domestic flights in the second quarter of 2025 did not arrive on-time — the tardiest performance since 2014.
Updated Oct 14, 2025 by theUSAFacts team
As of late September 2025, an average of more than 2.4 million people on average were clearing security in American airports every day. That figure is about 9% higher than the number of passengers in September 2019, the last comparison before the pandemic.
Two million commercial domestic flights were scheduled from April to June of 2025, about 3.5% lower than the same period in 2019.
In spring 2025, nearly a quarter of flights did not arrive on time. That’s the tardiest second quarter for commercial air travel since 2014.
The Bureau of Transportation Statistics defines a flight as on time if it arrives within 15 minutes of the originally scheduled time.

## What airlines are the best for on-time performance?
Nearly half of the commercial airlines in the US had fewer flights in the first half of 2025 compared with the same period in 2019. Twelve airlines — or 57% — had worse on-time performances in 2025 than in 2019.

# Airline On-Time Tables
These tables created by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) summarize and provide historical comparisons of monthly on-time reports filed by large airlines. Flights are on-time if they depart from the gate or arrive at the gate less than 15 minutes after their scheduled departure or arrival times. For annual rankings, click on December, then select the year-to-date rankings.
Additional on-time information can be found in the Air Travel Consumer Report, http://www.transportation.gov/individuals/air-consumer/air-travel-consumer-reports.

# Airline On-Time Tables
These tables created by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) summarize and provide historical comparisons of monthly on-time reports filed by large airlines. Flights are on-time if they depart from the gate or arrive at the gate less than 15 minutes after their scheduled departure or arrival times. For annual rankings, click on December, then select the year-to-date rankings.
Additional on-time information can be found in the Air Travel Consumer Report, http://www.transportation.gov/individuals/air-consumer/air-travel-consumer-reports.

Updated Sep 25, 2026
**John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** in Queens is New York City’s primary international entry point and one of the busiest airports worldwide, connecting North America to destinations across six continents.

## In this article
*   How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?  
*   How many aircraft operations occur at John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?  
*   How much revenue does John F. Kennedy International Airport generate each year?  
*   Which terminals are busiest at John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   Which airlines carry the most passengers at John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   Where do John F. Kennedy International Airport's international passengers fly?  
*   JFK International Passengers by World Region  
*   What are the busiest routes at John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   When is the peak month at John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   How much cargo moves through John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?  
*   How often are flights on time at John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   How does John F. Kennedy International Airport rank globally?  
*   How do passengers get to and from John F. Kennedy International Airport?  
*   What is John F. Kennedy International Airport's economic impact?

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
Over **62 million passengers** are processed through John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport each year.
*   Before the pandemic, JFK Airport processed approximately **62.57 million passengers** annually in **2019**.1  
*   Annual processing dropped to a pandemic low of **16.63 million passengers** in **2020**, then recovered to **30.76 million** in **2021**, **55.08 million** in **2022**, **62.08 million** in **2023**, and a record **63.27 million** in **2024**.1  
*   In **2025**, JFK Airport processed **62.63 million passengers**1, **down 1%** from 2024 but still above 2019.

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### How many passengers have used John F. Kennedy International Airport in 2026 so far?
John F. Kennedy International Airport handled **40.07 million passengers** from **January to August 2026**, **down 5.6%** from **42.44 million** in the same months of 2025.2
*   **International passengers** accounted for approximately **55.0%** (**22.06 million****passengers**), while **domestic passengers** comprised **45.0%** (**18.01 million****passengers**) of year-to-date traffic.2

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### How many passengers have used John F. Kennedy International Airport in 2026 so far?
Source · Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, Airport Traffic Data (revenue passengers), data through August 2026.

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### How many passengers used John F. Kennedy International Airport in 2025?
John F. Kennedy International Airport handled **62.63 million passengers** in **2025**.1
*   **International passengers** accounted for approximately **55.1%** (**34.53 million****passengers**), while **domestic passengers** comprised **44.9%** (**28.10 million****passengers**) of total airport traffic.1

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### How many passengers used John F. Kennedy International Airport in 2024?
John F. Kennedy International Airport processed **63.27 million passengers** in 2024.1
*   **International passengers** accounted for approximately **55.7%** (**35.26 million****passengers**), while **domestic passengers** comprised **44.3%** (**28.01 million****passengers**) of total airport traffic.1

## How many passengers use John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### How large is John F. Kennedy International Airport?
John F. Kennedy International Airport spans approximately **4,930 acres** of land in Queens, New York.1
*   **Runways:** 4 runways ranging from 8,400 to 14,511 feet in length.3  
*   **Terminals:** 5 passenger terminals with 125 gates.1  
*   **Parking spaces:** Approximately 10,600 public parking spaces.1

## How many aircraft operations occur at John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
Over **464,000****aircraft operations** (including takeoffs and landings) occur at John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport each year.
*   Before the pandemic, JFK Airport handled approximately **456,179****operations** in 2019 across all categories.1  
*   Airport operations fell to **199,767****operations** in **2020** (down **56%** due to COVID-19), then gradually recovered to **290,355** in **2021**, **448,341** in **2022** (achieving **98%** of pre-pandemic levels), **479,026** in **2023**, and **468,570** in **2024**.1  
*   The airport handled **464,281** operations in **2025**1, **down approximately 1%** from 2024.

## How many aircraft operations occur at John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### Aircraft Operations in 2025
John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport handled **464,281****aircraft operations** in **2025**.1
*   **Domestic****operations** accounted for approximately **59.6%** (**276,704****operations**), while **international****operations** comprised **40.4%** (**187,577****operations**) of total airport activity.1

## How many aircraft operations occur at John F. Kennedy International Airport each year?
### Aircraft Operations in 2024
John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport processed **468,570****aircraft operations** in **2024**.1
*   **Domestic operations** accounted for approximately **58.9%** (**276,088****operations**), while **international operations** comprised **41.1%** (**192,482****operations**) of total airport activity, with total operations reaching **103%** of pre-pandemic (2019) levels.1

About **75.4%** of domestic flights by reporting US airlines arrived on time at John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport in **2025**,12 and **77.3%** departed on time, based on the US Department of Transportation's monthly figures.13
*   That is slightly below the national rate of **76.4%** on-time arrivals in 2025.13  
*   **September** was the most punctual month, with **84.1%** of flights arriving on time.14  
*   **July** was the worst, with only **62.4%** arriving on time15, followed by **June** (**66.9%**)16 and **December** (**68.9%**).13  
*   A flight counts as on time when it arrives or departs less than 15 minutes after its scheduled time.13

## How do passengers get to and from John F. Kennedy International Airport?
**Ridesharing** is the most common way to reach John F. Kennedy International (JFK) Airport, used by **21.9%** of departing passengers in **2025**, just ahead of being **dropped off by car** (**21.5%**).1
*   **Taxis and limos** brought **16.2%** of departing passengers and **rail or subway****15.9%**, while **3.0%** arrived by **rental car**.1  
*   **AirTrain JFK** carried **25.78 million passengers** in 2025, **up 3.5%** from 2024 and **23% more** than in 2019.1  
*   **1.65 million cars** paid to park at JFK in 2025, **down 7.2%** from 2024 and less than half the **3.34 million** in 2019.1  
*   Taxi dispatchers loaded **1.97 million passengers** at JFK in 2025, **up 4.5%** from 2024.1

## CLT on-time performance, delays and cancellations (2025)
In **2025**, **74%** of CLT's domestic flights left on time and **79%** arrived on time, up from **72%** and **76%** in **2024**.25
*   **On-time arrival ranking (2025):**7th among major US airports, with **79.37%** of flights arriving on time26  
*   **Cancellations (2025):** 1.71% of scheduled flights, up from 1.37% in 202425  
*   **Average delay (2025):** 70.58 minutes for delayed departures and 89.17 minutes for delayed arrivals25

## How big is Charlotte Douglas Airport? Size, gates and parking
CLT covers about **6,000 acres** in Charlotte, North Carolina.4
*   **Terminal complex:** one main terminal and five concourses (A–E) with 123 gates2  
*   **Parking:** about 25,000 spaces4

## Charlotte Douglas Airport's economic impact
A 2023 study put CLT's annual economic impact at **US$40 billion**.10
*   **Tax revenue:** US$2.1 billion in state and local taxes10  
*   **Contribution to GDP:****5%** of North Carolina's gross product10

## CLT on-time performance, delays and cancellations (2025)
In **2025**, **74%** of CLT's domestic flights left on time and **79%** arrived on time, up from **72%** and **76%** in **2024**.25
*   **On-time arrival ranking (2025):**7th among major US airports, with **79.37%** of flights arriving on time26  
*   **Cancellations (2025):** 1.71% of scheduled flights, up from 1.37% in 202425  
*   **Average delay (2025):** 70.58 minutes for delayed departures and 89.17 minutes for delayed arrivals25
texts.18:
## How big is Charlotte Douglas Airport? Size, gates and parking
CLT covers about **6,000 acres** in Charlotte, North Carolina.4
*   **Terminal complex:** one main terminal and five concourses (A–E) with 123 gates2  
*   **Parking:** about 25,000 spaces4
texts.19:
## Charlotte Douglas Airport's economic impact
A 2023 study put CLT's annual economic impact at **US$40 billion**.10
*   **Tax revenue:** US$2.1 billion in state and local taxes10  
*   **Contribution to GDP:****5%** of North Carolina's gross product10

## CLT on-time performance, delays and cancellations (2025)
In **2025**, **74%** of CLT's domestic flights left on time and **79%** arrived on time, up from **72%** and **76%** in **2024**.25
*   **On-time arrival ranking (2025):**7th among major US airports, with **79.37%** of flights arriving on time26  
*   **Cancellations (2025):** 1.71% of scheduled flights, up from 1.37% in 202425  
*   **Average delay (2025):** 70.58 minutes for delayed departures and 89.17 minutes for delayed arrivals25

## How big is Charlotte Douglas Airport? Size, gates and parking
CLT covers about **6,000 acres** in Charlotte, North Carolina.4
*   **Terminal complex:** one main terminal and five concourses (A–E) with 123 gates2  
*   **Parking:** about 25,000 spaces4

## Charlotte Douglas Airport's economic impact
A 2023 study put CLT's annual economic impact at **US$40 billion**.10
*   **Tax revenue:** US$2.1 billion in state and local taxes10  
*   **Contribution to GDP:****5%** of North Carolina's gross product10

## CLT on-time performance, delays and cancellations (2025)
In **2025**, **74%** of CLT's domestic flights left on time and **79%** arrived on time, up from **72%** and **76%** in **2024**.25
*   **On-time arrival ranking (2025):**7th among major US airports, with **79.37%** of flights arriving on time26  
*   **Cancellations (2025):** 1.71% of scheduled flights, up from 1.37% in 202425  
*   **Average delay (2025):** 70.58 minutes for delayed departures and 89.17 minutes for delayed arrivals25

## How big is Charlotte Douglas Airport? Size, gates and parking
CLT covers about **6,000 acres** in Charlotte, North Carolina.4
*   **Terminal complex:** one main terminal and five concourses (A–E) with 123 gates2  
*   **Parking:** about 25,000 spaces4

## Charlotte Douglas Airport's economic impact
A 2023 study put CLT's annual economic impact at **US$40 billion**.10
*   **Tax revenue:** US$2.1 billion in state and local taxes10  
*   **Contribution to GDP:****5%** of North Carolina's gross product10

## CLT on-time performance, delays and cancellations (2025)
In **2025**, **74%** of CLT's domestic flights left on time and **79%** arrived on time, up from **72%** and **76%** in **2024**.25
*   **On-time arrival ranking (2025):**7th among major US airports, with **79.37%** of flights arriving on time26  
*   **Cancellations (2025):** 1.71% of scheduled flights, up from 1.37% in 202425  
*   **Average delay (2025):** 70.58 minutes for delayed departures and 89.17 minutes for delayed arrivals25

## How big is Charlotte Douglas Airport? Size, gates and parking
CLT covers about **6,000 acres** in Charlotte, North Carolina.4
*   **Terminal complex:** one main terminal and five concourses (A–E) with 123 gates2  
*   **Parking:** about 25,000 spaces4

## Charlotte Douglas Airport's economic impact
A 2023 study put CLT's annual economic impact at **US$40 billion**.10
*   **Tax revenue:** US$2.1 billion in state and local taxes10  
*   **Contribution to GDP:****5%** of North Carolina's gross product10

Based on my extensive search through the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) resources and related data sources, I must inform you that I was unable to retrieve the complete **Table 4** datasets containing the full rankings and percentages for both calendar year 2023 and 2024 needed to definitively answer your question.

Here's what I found:

## Available Information

1. **BTS Table 4 exists** - The Bureau of Transportation Statistics publishes "Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance" as Table 4 annually

2. **Data source confirmed** - An embedded Excel dataset is available at [bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports](https://www.bts.gov/annual-time-arrival-rankings-major-airports)

3. **Reference files exist** - Multiple documents cite "Table 4: Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance Year-to-date December 2003–December 2024" and "2023"

4. **Sample partial data points** found in searches:
   - Charlotte CLT: 79.37% in 2025 (up from 76% in 2024)
   - JFK: ~77.3% departures in 2025, below national rate
   - SLC mentioned as having high on-time performance in 2025

## Limitation

To accurately identify airports meeting ALL your criteria:
- Classified as US major airports by DOT
- Improved by at least one ranking position from 2023 to 2024
- 2024 on-time percentage ≥77.0% and ≤81.5%

I would need direct access to the complete BTS Table 4 spreadsheets for both 2023 and 2024 calendar years, which contain:
- Complete ranking positions for each major airport
- On-time arrival percentages for each airport
- All US DOT-defined major airports included in the ranking

**Recommendation:** To get this information, I recommend:
1. Download the "Table 4 Ranking of Major Airport On-Time Arrival Performance" Excel files directly from the BTS website for years 2023 and 2024
2. Filter for US airports only
3. Calculate rank improvements (new rank minus old rank = positive value means improvement)
4. Filter for 2024 on-time percentages between 77.0% and 81.5%
